description: This file defines the interface for the AOM encoder, including data structures, constants, and function prototypes for encoding video streams using the Alliance for Open Media codec.

methods.name: aom_codec_enc_init_ver
methods.description: Initializes an encoder context with specified interface, configuration, flags, and version.

methods.name: aom_codec_enc_init_multi_ver
methods.description: Initializes a multi-encoder context with specified parameters and version.

methods.name: aom_codec_enc_config_default
methods.description: Populates a configuration structure with default encoder settings.

methods.name: aom_codec_enc_config_set
methods.description: Reconfigures an encoder instance with a new configuration.

methods.name: aom_codec_get_global_headers
methods.description: Retrieves global headers for the stream if supported.

methods.name: aom_codec_encode
methods.description: Encodes a video frame with specified timestamp, duration, and flags.

methods.name: aom_codec_set_cx_data_buf
methods.description: Sets the output buffer for compressed data.

methods.name: aom_codec_get_cx_data
methods.description: Iterates over encoded data packets produced by the encoder.

methods.name: aom_codec_get_preview_frame
methods.description: Returns a preview image of the current frame.
